reports.title: Acadia Realty Trust Reports Third Quarter 2026 Operating Results

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: The Company has maintained its full-year NAREIT FFO and 2026 FFO As Adjusted Guidance. It revised net earnings per share to $0.29-$0.30 from $0.40-$0.41.

Revised | Prior
Net earnings per share attributable to Acadia | $0.29-$0.30 | $0.40-$0.41
Depreciation of real estate and amortization of leasing costs (net of noncontrolling interest share other than Common OP Units) | 1.00-1.01 | 0.96-0.97
Gain on disposition of real estate properties (net of noncontrolling interest share other than Common OP Units) | (0.25) | (0.24)
Impairment charges (net of noncontrolling interest share other than Common OP Units) | 0.08 | —
Adjustment of redeemable noncontrolling interest to estimated redemption value | 0.04 | 0.04
Noncontrolling interest in Operating Partnership | 0.03 | 0.03
NAREIT FFO per share attributable to Common Shareholders and Common OP Unit Holders | $1.19-$1.21 | $1.19-$1.21
Transaction and other expenses 1 | 0.05 | 0.05
FFO As Adjusted per share attributable to Common Shareholders and Common OP Unit Holders 2 | $1.24-$1.26 | $1.24-$1.26

Transaction and other expenses include those costs that the Company believes are not reflective of ongoing core operating results, including investment transaction costs, debt extinguishment costs and employee retirement costs.
Refer to the Notes to Financial Highlights for definitions of non-GAAP measures.

Management will conduct a conference call on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 11:00 AM ET to review the Company’s earnings and operating results. Participant registration and webcast information is listed below.

Date: | Monday, November 2, 2026
Time: | 11:00 AM ET
Participant call: | Third Quarter 2026 Dial-In
Participant webcast: | Third Quarter 2026 Webcast
Webcast Listen-only and Replay: | www.acadiarealty.com/investors under Events, Presentations & Portfolio Updates

The Company uses, and intends to use, the Investors page of its website, which can be found at https://www.acadiarealty.com/investors, as a means of disclosing material nonpublic information and of complying with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD, including, without limitation, through the posting of investor presentations and certain portfolio updates. Additionally, the Company uses its LinkedIn profile to communicate with its investors and the public. Accordingly, investors are encouraged to monitor the Investors page of the Company's website and its LinkedIn profile, in addition to following the Company’s press releases, SEC filings, public conference calls, presentations and webcasts.
